Scrape off another remaining patch of skin.
Trim away skin around the onion's end and discard the scraps.
Remove the last visible patch of dry outer skin.
Cut the peeled onion into two halves.
Place both onion halves on the board for slicing.
Make a series of parallel cuts through the left onion half.
Turn the sliced onion half and make crosswise cuts to dice it.
